text:
nina-sales: Velorum procurement ping 30. They want a quick sanity benchmark to validate thin-client assumptions before we finalize MSA. Target is 150 qps sustained, with p95 < 200ms for single-turn text-gen. Can ops run a 10m proof and give a simple cost delta between hosted vs dedicated?
omar-eng: We can. Need: model variant, avg prompt+gen tokens, region, and whether to include cold-cache run.
sui-ml: Use redwood/v2-small-q4 as primary (quantized) and v2-base as a comparison for latency. Prompts are tiny: ~25 tokens in, ~20 out. Include cold-cache (no KV) and warm-cache.
nina-sales: Region: us-west-2. Customer wants ability to shed to cheaper model on peak. Also asks about per-call auth header retention for audit.
ravi-ops: Draft run plan: 1) 2m warmup at 15 qps, 2) ramp 2m to 150 qps, 3) sustain 6m at 150 qps, 4) 30s microburst @ 350 qps, 5) 2m cool down. Collect p50/p95/p99, queueing rates, and batch size distribution.
ravi-ops: k6 profile command I intend to use:
```bash
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 10m --out json=velorum_run.json k6_velorum_thin.js
```
omar-eng: Server side: plan for 2 workers (T4s or A10s?). For US-WEST small quantized should hit p95 ~120-160ms on 2xT4s with batching window 30ms and KV cache on. If we want strict p95<200ms, 1xA10 might also do but safer to use 2xT4.
sui-ml: Also run an adversarial path: disable KV cache and set max output tokens to 128 to measure worst-case. Add a 60s sustained spike at 500 qps to observe shedding/fallback.
maya-se: Security note: Velorum flagged "request headers retained for troubleshooting" and encryption at rest. For this run: we log RequestID, model_version, timestamp, worker_region. No plaintext customer data persisted. For enterprise evals we can enable KMS + audit export on Private.
nina-sales: Cost ask: quick back-of-envelope for a 1-hour dedicated run (2xT4 reserved) vs hosted burn for the same traffic.
ravi-ops: Quick math: 150 qps * 20 tokens * 3600s = 43.2M tokens/hr. Hosted list price at q4 quantized ~ $0.08 per 1M tokens -> ~ $3.46/hr in tokens (hosted compute included) (note: rough). Dedicated infra (2xT4 reserved amortized) ~ $6/hr + runtime overhead ~ $10/hr total. If they max at 500 qps spikes, burst capacity adds ~ $3-5/hr.
omar-eng: I'll capture traces and per-token breakdown (batch formation, kernel execution, serialization). That will help show where latency is spent.
maya-se: Suggested wording for security note: "Smoke runs mask customer inputs; only metadata (requestID, model, timestamp, worker) are logged. KMS-backed encryption and audit exports available on Private deployments per contract"
nina-sales: Can you confirm by EOD? I told them we'd have numbers and a short run artifact.
omar-eng: I'll start the tests now and post results by 19:00 PT. No HSM/SSO blockers for this quick run; long-term integrations need formal scoping.
sui-ml: License check: open model variants are fine. If they request export controls or signed T&Cs for embeddings, escalate.
load-bot: load-bot: created loadtest job job_id=lt-4112345678-1 status=queued
ravi-ops: I'll upload the k6 script and a 1-page README into the prospect folder when done.
nina-sales: Great work — I'll ping procurement and ask them to send any security forms. :rocket:
